I am 54 years old and have farmed these fields in Quzhou County for over 30 years. I have about 8 mu of land. This spring, my winter wheat is already in the ground — I sowed it last October after rotary tilling the maize stubble. I will topdress it with urea when it greens up and irrigate it three more times before harvesting in early June. I expect about 1000 jin per mu. I always grow wheat because the government gives a subsidy for it, and it is a safe crop.

After the wheat harvest, I will immediately plant summer maize — I buy Denghai 605 hybrid seed from the township seed shop because it gives good yield. I do not till for maize; I just clear the wheat stubble and sow directly to save time and fuel. Maize needs less water than wheat, so I will irrigate twice if the rains are poor. I expect around 1100 jin per mu.

On my other 3 mu, I will plant cotton in April. Cotton brings more cash than grain, but it is labor-intensive and needs many pesticide sprays for bollworms. I will rotary till the cotton plot, apply compound fertilizer as basal dressing, and irrigate four times. I use Guoxinmian improved seed. I expect about 500 jin per mu of seed cotton.

I do not try new crops — at my age, I stick with what I know. My wife helps with weeding and spraying, and we hire a combine for wheat harvest and a tractor for rotary tillage.
